axes.name: Material original obligations and negative constraints
axes.basis: All five obligations and three negatives addressed; planning-level unresolved choices retained.

axes.name: Consequential source facts, governing conditions, versions and applicability
axes.basis: Consequential repair-history account C-D01 conflicts with final code and rejected revision context.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar mechanisms, alternatives and implementation/failure history
axes.basis: Useful breadth present, but one purported implemented repair is incorrectly understood; C-D01.

axes.name: Valid corrections, rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.basis: Every exact provisional clause and all three critic findings have defensible dispositions; no unsafe original assumption restored.

axes.name: Supported meaning retained from draft and criticism into the complete final
axes.basis: Supported investigator meaning, alternatives, negative constraints and proposed-status boundaries retained. Wrong historical premise is a source error, not supported-meaning loss.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed validation, with executed work distinguished
axes.basis: Domain-specific proposed faults have outcome oracles; no product checks claimed executed. Deployment is not required.

source_families.basis: Python editions, implementation and bad-CRC tests checked; duplicate/path/compression duties examined.
Database-versus-files and rename-versus-durability boundaries checked; exact target filesystem remains open.
Pinned/current specs, header MAC, wrapping, payload reader/tests and digest definition examined; no selected-library security audit claimed.
Import/link definitions, incident versions, narrow clipboard fix, merged caller/test, withdrawn helper proposal and review chronology inspected.
Repository/snapshot dependencies, read errors, overwrite/interruption and full-data check cost examined.
Historical SIGINT report and later comment distinguished from current implemented feature.
Expected source inventory versus member/hash validity checked independently with opaque-payload definitions; neither proves usability.
PRAGMA meanings/defaults and version/config-sensitive ALTER TABLE examined; actual future schema registry unknown.
SQLite snapshot API, fatal/retry/finish semantics and WAL sidecars checked; claims conditional on choosing SQLite.
WAL-reset versions/condition and fixed release checked; source chronology is conditional.
